summary: The expand_customer_note and backfill_customer_note stages passed with no failed checks. The contract stage contract_drop_note was refused by the retirement gate because the old app version remained alive (old_alive: true), preventing the note column from being dropped while both app versions served traffic concurrently.
revision_notes: The retirement gate enforced old_alive: false before dropping the note column. The old app had not been retired prior to the contract stage, likely because the retire_old stage was not executed or completed beforehand.

stages.description: Add new column customer_note to account_user table, nullable text, allowing both old and new app versions to operate.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Copy existing note values into customer_note so the new app can read the most recent write.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Remove the old note column after data has been migrated and both app versions have been updated to use customer_note.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;

stages.description: Deploy the new app version (new-staged) with state-only Django migration; the new code expects column customer_note.
Retire the old app version (old) after the new version is serving traffic and the note column has been dropped.
